harnessNotes.*: This skill drives the packages/videoeditor engine. Build it once with `npm run build` there, and set VIDEOEDITOR_HOME to its folder if you copied the skill folder by hand instead of using the install command. The review server binds to 127.0.0.1 by default; exposing it on the LAN or Tailscale requires an explicit --bind 0.0.0.0.
harnessNotes.opencode: Every edit tool prints a `checks` array. Run `review --out <file>` for a static HTML report that needs no server.
